name: Greater Transit Zone
description: This dataset defines the Greater Transit Zone, a geographic boundary used in housing and development planning. It contains a single sampled record with three fields: a zone identifier (gtz_qs) and the geometric length and area of the zone's boundary. The data is essentially a spatial outline of the zone rather than a table of many observations. It could be used to map the zone, calculate its size, or overlay it with housing, land-use, or transit datasets to analyze development potential and policy coverage within the area.
